stages.title: Sunset Overpass
stages.scenario_goal: Break the Iron Veil roadblock and free the transport cages
stages.win_condition: Defeat Brask Noll before the cages leave the overpass

stage_events.title: ROAD COLLAPSE
stage_events.body: Extraction spike overloaded. Service lane exposed.

opening_story.speaker: Kian
opening_story.line: Fresh drill marks under the asphalt. Iron Veil built this roadblock to crack the route.

opening_story.speaker: Nika
opening_story.line: Those cages are moving. If Iron Veil gets the young ones loaded, the whole herd panics.

opening_story.speaker: Kian
opening_story.line: Then I plant the wrench, break their loading line, and keep the routes open.

stage_barks.wave_start: Kian: One grunt first. Watch the swing, then answer with the wrench.
stage_barks.cage_loading: Nika: Cages on the right. Move before they roll out.
stage_barks.service_lane: Kian: Lower lane exposed. Boots down, road tool ready.
stage_barks.boss_warning: Nika: Big axe, bigger ego. Let him overcommit.

boss_story.intro_line: End of the ride. Iron Veil field authority.
boss_story.phase_line: Fine. Road comes down with you on it.

stages.opening_cutscene: Roadblock ahead. Kian steps out with the reinforced wrench while Iron Veil cages roll toward the trucks.
stages.ending_cutscene: Brask escapes by helicopter platform. The rescued beacon points toward the jungle lab.

stages.title: Glassleaf Jungle
stages.scenario_goal: Smash the handler rigs and push through the spore lab
stages.win_condition: Break the Glassback control collar without losing the fight
stages.opening_cutscene: The beacon leads into a glowing research district. Something is forcing panic into the wildlife.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Glassback is freed from the control collar. Its trail leads to Ember Rest.

stages.title: Ember Rest Market
stages.scenario_goal: Protect the market lanes and expose Iron Veil infiltrators
stages.opening_cutscene: Ember Rest should be safe, but Iron Veil has already slipped into the market.
stages.ending_cutscene: Sable Rin vanishes through the rooftops, leaving a rail manifest behind.

stages.title: Mineral Rail
stages.scenario_goal: Fight across the moving cargo line and stop drill shipments
stages.win_condition: Overheat the Rail Maw and destroy its exposed core
stages.opening_cutscene: The crew boards a cargo train carrying Deep Crown drill parts.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Rail Maw tears loose and falls into the canyon. The next stop is Ashforge.

stages.title: Ashforge Town
stages.scenario_goal: Cross molten factory streets and break the exo-frame unit
stages.win_condition: Crack Vorrak's armor phases and force his squad to retreat
stages.opening_cutscene: Tor knows this place. He helped guard it before he changed sides.
stages.ending_cutscene: Vorrak's exo-frame breaks. The mobile lab is fleeing across the storm plain.

stages.title: Storm Plain Chase
stages.scenario_goal: Board the mobile lab convoy during the lightning chase
stages.win_condition: Expose and smash Klade's control tower
stages.opening_cutscene: Purple lightning breaks over the badlands as the Sundrifter catches Klade's lab.
stages.ending_cutscene: Klade's control tower explodes. A tunnel opens into the Underroot.

stages.title: The Underroot
stages.scenario_goal: Fight carefully through the living crystal nest
stages.win_condition: Shatter mutation crystals until the Echo Queen retreats
stages.opening_cutscene: The living root network hums under the continent. Loud fights wake dangerous nests.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Echo Queen backs away from her nest as the mutation crystals go dark.

stages.title: Deep Crown Citadel
stages.scenario_goal: Storm the drilling fortress and shut down the Deep Crown
stages.win_condition: Defeat Mara's armor and destroy the exposed power nodes
stages.opening_cutscene: Mara Voss activates the Deep Crown. The rift starts to collapse.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Deep Crown shuts down without killing the rift. Dawn reaches the open road.

final_ending: Kian says the rift is stabilizing. Nika says healing can go faster. Tor smiles. Raya listens to the engine and says the road's open.
